account.name: L'Oréal
account.context: Exploring data activation for the DTC push. Early stage. Champion identified, budget owner unknown.

transcript: L'Oréal discovery call — July 6. Present: Antoine Mercier (Growth Lead, L'Oréal), Léa Fontan (Data Analyst, L'Oréal), and Alex on our side. Antoine: "Our DTC push needs better data activation, we're evaluating three vendors this month." Léa: "The integration looks straightforward on our side." Antoine: "Final call sits with Sophie, our VP Digital — she owns the vendor budget." Open commitments: send a comparison one-pager, schedule a technical deep-dive. Sales angle: vendor evaluation closing this month, decision-maker = Sophie (VP Digital), not on the call.

email.subject: Your VivaTech DTC roadmap — vendor shortlist input
email.body:
Hi Sophie,

Your VivaTech talk on the DTC roadmap resonated — data activation is exactly where we help.

Antoine and Léa are evaluating us this month; Léa confirmed the integration is straightforward on your side. Before the shortlist closes, I'd value 15 minutes to show you how we frame the comparison.

One-pager attached.

Best,
Alex
